security-reviewer: Webhook handlers verify the provider signature on the raw body before any side effect
Every table has row-level security enabled with explicit policies
Secret keys are server-only and never imported into client components or NEXT_PUBLIC_ vars
Every route handler and server action checks auth and ownership
code-reviewer: Webhook handlers are idempotent on the provider event id
Subscription and entitlement state is derived from the provider, not a client flag
Failed or retried webhooks cannot leave the database half-updated
executor: Never trust a client-sent price, amount, or plan id; resolve it server-side
Keep secrets in server-only modules and env vars

code-reviewer: Checkout cannot oversell stock under concurrent orders (atomic decrement or reservation)
Cart totals and prices come from the server, never from client state
Out-of-stock and error states are handled in cart and checkout
seo-reviewer: Product pages emit valid Product JSON-LD with price, currency, and availability
Variant and filter URLs have correct canonical tags
perf-reviewer: Product images have explicit sizes and the hero image is prioritized for LCP
Listing pages paginate or virtualize instead of loading the full catalog

seo-reviewer: Every page has a unique title, description, and Open Graph image
Canonical URL is set and absolute on every page
New routes appear in the sitemap and RSS feed
One h1 per page with no skipped heading levels
Every image has meaningful alt text
code-reviewer: Frontmatter fields are validated against a schema, not assumed
Draft or unpublished content is excluded from production builds and feeds

perf-reviewer: Repeated meshes use instancing; report draw-call count for the main scene
Textures are sized for display and compressed (KTX2), models use Draco or meshopt
Geometries, materials, and textures are disposed on unmount
Frame budget holds on mid-tier mobile (target 16ms; no per-frame allocations)
code-reviewer: Animations and render loops are cleaned up on unmount (rAF, ScrollTrigger, listeners)
A prefers-reduced-motion fallback exists for every scripted animation
design-reviewer: Loading state and non-WebGL fallback render sensibly at mobile width
